title: Repeated String Match
description: Given non-empty strings `a` and `b`, repeat `a` the fewest number of times so that `b` appears as a contiguous substring of the repeated string. Return that repetition count, or -1 if no repetition can contain `b`. Input: `a`, `b`. Output: the minimum count or -1.
constraints: a and b contain lowercase English letters
hints: Track only the character counts or prefixes needed to decide the next step.
Check repeated symbols, empty or minimal cases, and impossible arrangements.
